This berry is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in deciduous or mixed forests, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

Coraco berries from Suza Sumar are pressed into a concentrated juice. A dose of eight ounces, specific to this preparation, restores 2–20 concussion hits; producing it requires roughly two large buckets of berries. This very low yield explains the quantity of fruit needed. The concentrate keeps for six months.
